svg.title: Build an Investable Acquisition Process in Thirty Days
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-first-thirty-days-execution-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Build an Investable Acquisition Process in Thirty Days; subtitle: Four weekly milestones prepare the pipeline, not a promised closing.; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Milestones cover Days 1–7, 8–14, 15–21, and 22–30. Numeric values mark milestone end days. The canonical first-deal window remains 3–9 months. A completed sprint produces traceable research, underwriting, and operating controls; it does not establish ownership or royalty income.; caption: Finish the month with a narrow acquisition mandate, a documented evidence trail, tested economics, and a review-ready offer process.; stages: label: Days 1-7: define mandate and evidence standards; value: Complete basin scope, capital limits, and record templates; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one initial basin and asset type. Establish county recorder and state commission access, the investment register, and secure document storage. Write separate fields for NMA, NPRI terms, lease royalty, unit allocation, and operator pay decimal.; label: Days 8-14: build the first traceable sourcing cohort; value: Complete a sourced shortlist with ownership evidence links; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Assemble an illustrative 25-package pilot from authorized seller outreach and public records. Deduplicate interests, collect instrument references, and log seller authority. Monitor relevant public pooling dockets without equating filings with funded development.; label: Days 15-21: underwrite and challenge candidate economics; value: Complete three conditional cases and reproducible reconciliations; numeric value: 21.0; detail: For three candidates with sufficient evidence, build commodity, decline, deduction, and timing sensitivities. Reconcile available royalty statements using Python csv and sqlite3. Compare legal ownership math with operator decimals and document every unresolved difference before setting offer limits.; label: Days 22-30: prepare offers and operating handoffs; value: Complete reviewed offer packs and a funded runway plan; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Prepare conditional offers only for supported candidates. Assign title remediation, closing deliverables, operator transfer tracking, and royalty exception ownership. Reconcile acquisition commitments with liquidity through the 3–9 month first-deal window; retain unresolved candidates in research.

circle.title: label: Days 1-7: define mandate and evidence standards; value: Complete basin scope, capital limits, and record templates; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Choose one initial basin and asset type. Establish county recorder and state commission access, the investment register, and secure document storage. Write separate fields for NMA, NPRI terms, lease royalty, unit allocation, and operator pay decimal.

text.title: Days 1-7: define mandate and evidence standards
Complete basin scope, capital limits, and record templates

circle.title: label: Days 8-14: build the first traceable sourcing cohort; value: Complete a sourced shortlist with ownership evidence links; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Assemble an illustrative 25-package pilot from authorized seller outreach and public records. Deduplicate interests, collect instrument references, and log seller authority. Monitor relevant public pooling dockets without equating filings with funded development.

text.title: Days 8-14: build the first traceable sourcing cohort
Complete a sourced shortlist with ownership evidence links

circle.title: label: Days 15-21: underwrite and challenge candidate economics; value: Complete three conditional cases and reproducible reconciliations; numeric value: 21.0; detail: For three candidates with sufficient evidence, build commodity, decline, deduction, and timing sensitivities. Reconcile available royalty statements using Python csv and sqlite3. Compare legal ownership math with operator decimals and document every unresolved difference before setting offer limits.

text.title: Days 15-21: underwrite and challenge candidate economics
Complete three conditional cases and reproducible reconciliations

circle.title: label: Days 22-30: prepare offers and operating handoffs; value: Complete reviewed offer packs and a funded runway plan; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Prepare conditional offers only for supported candidates. Assign title remediation, closing deliverables, operator transfer tracking, and royalty exception ownership. Reconcile acquisition commitments with liquidity through the 3–9 month first-deal window; retain unresolved candidates in research.

text.title: Days 22-30: prepare offers and operating handoffs
Complete reviewed offer packs and a funded runway plan
